# NetAigis Coding Chat – fork independence

This repository is owned by the GitHub user **net-aigis**. It is **not** part of the
Cline GitHub organization and is **not** a GitHub network fork of `cline/cline`.

- **Write access:** only net-aigis. The Cline org cannot push, force-push, or
  change settings on this repository.
- **Upstream:** `https://github.com/cline/cline` is a read-only code reference
  (`upstream` remote, push disabled). Pulling upstream is a deliberate local
  choice; nothing from Cline is applied automatically.
- **Publishing:** Cline Marketplace / Open VSX / Cline org JetBrains workflows
  are disabled on this repository. Do not re-enable them with Cline secrets.
- **Identity:** product identity is `netaigis.netaigis-coding-chat` (see
  `apps/vscode/package.json` and `fork-provenance.json`).
